why: The real Basecamp Pro Unlimited window. A flat organisation-wide price on a page whose other plan is per-user, sitting beside a storage figure written as a multiple of that other plan (`10x Pro`) and a trial length in days. The synthetic set has per-user prices and it has flat prices; it has never had one that a model could turn into the other by reading one line too far.
